newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - New issues dominate NYSE volume.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - New issues dominate NYSE volume.

text.p: Share of JLK Direct Distribution Systems and Comfort Systems USA Inc were the top two heavily traded stocks on the New York Stocks Exchange after their initial public offerings Friday.
Both jumped sharply, with JLK adding 27.5 percent, or 5-1/2 to 25-1/2 even after pricing at $20 a share, the high end of the offering's expected range.

The company first filed for an offering of 4.257 million Class A shares to price for $16 to $18 but later jacked the range up to $18 to $20 due to heavy demand. Volume in JLK Direct stood at about 2.6 million shares just after midday.
